items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: my cousin Clarice was working for some people

ctx.x: His name was Alexander Augustine. And my cousin Clarice was working for some people, and they gave her a piano. Well, her place was too small for a piano, because it was one of these big concert pianos. And my mother, she had a great big room. So she had to give the piano to my mother, because she couldn't fit it in her house. And that's how my brother learned to play the piano.
